n3.attention-raknat-for-hand.2: One head, three tokens and two dimensions instead of 128. We work out what “den” fetches from “Katten”, “satt” and itself. Every number below is computed, nothing is made up.
n3.forward-pass-som-kod.1: The whole forward pass as code
n3.forward-pass-som-kod.2: Everything in the module on one screen, as PyTorch-like pseudocode for one sequence. Compare line by line with the tensor trace.
n3.forward-pass-som-kod.3: The same function does both prefill and decode. The only difference is T: in prefill, T is the length of the prompt and the cache is empty; in decode, T = 1 and the cache holds everything from before.
n3.forward-pass-som-kod.4: repeat_kv shows GQA as an idea: each KV head is used by 4 query heads. Real kernels copy nothing, they only index.
n3.forward-pass-som-kod.5: The code in vLLM (models/llama.py) has the same structure: qkv_proj, o_proj, gate_up_proj, down_proj. Attention and cache handling live in a separate backend.
n3.forward-pass-som-kod.6: def forward(ids, pos, cache): # ids [T] x = E[ids] # [T, 4096] for l in range(32): h = rmsnorm(x, g1[l]) # [T, 4096] q, k, v = split(h @ W_qkv[l]) # [T,4096] [T,1024] [T,1024] q = q.view(T, 32, 128).transpose(0, 1) # [32, T, 128] k = k.view(T, 8, 128).transpose(0, 1) # [ 8, T, 128] v = v.view(T, 8, 128).transpose(0, 1) # [ 8, T, 128] q, k = rope(q, pos), rope(k, pos) K, V = cache[l].append(k, v) # [8, ctx, 128] ctx = old + T K, V = repeat_kv(K, 4), repeat_kv(V, 4) # [32, ctx, 128] S = q @ K.transpose(-1, -2) / sqrt(128) # [32, T, ctx] S = S + causal_mask # −inf where the key comes after the query P = softmax(S, dim=-1) # [32, T, ctx] o = (P @ V).transpose(0, 1).reshape(T, 4096) x = x + o @ W_o[l] # [T, 4096] h = rmsnorm(x, g2[l]) gate, up = split(h @ W_gate_up[l]) # [T, 14336] × 2 x = x + (silu(gate) * up) @ W_down[l] # [T, 4096] h = rmsnorm(x[-1], g_final) # [4096] only the last position return h @ W_U # [128256] logits
